title: Air Force flies Benowitz to Archuleta Mesa with props staged
place_text: Archuleta Mesa, Jicarilla Apache reservation, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Paul was very excited when he told him that the Air Force had taken him in a helicopter from Kirtland,

plain: In the early 1980s, the story goes, the Air Force flew a New Mexico man named Paul Bennewitz by helicopter from Kirtland Air Force Base to Archuleta Mesa on the Jicarilla Apache reservation, where props had been set up for him to see. The writer Greg Bishop relays it second-hand from people involved, saying "Paul was very excited" when he described the trip. If true, the military staged a scene to shape what Bennewitz believed.
